samples.checks: The strict bound, least-witness condition and source-specific fallback y are all explicit.

samples.reverse_paraphrase: At y+1, retain an earlier witness if present; otherwise return y if R(x,y); otherwise return y+1. The recurrence detects the first case by m_R(x,y)≠y.
samples.checks: All three cases, their priority and the iff test are preserved. OLCMP-005 corrects vector z to the fixed parameter vector x in the third case.
